nativeAdaptations: Replace the apt/curl/uv installation prefix with pinned private Python 3.13.9, pytest 8.4.1 and pytest-json-ctrf 0.3.5 provisioning.
Replace the original uvx executable prefix with the absolute private Python isolated pytest console script; retain original --ctrf, selected test path, -rA, and reward branch.
Map complete Python path literals to the reconstructed workspace and verifier tree. Encode META input as a Scheme quoted absolute filename inside a Python string literal.

The original Scheme read retains escape bytes. For workspace filenames containing double quotes, backslashes or line breaks, create a unique mkdtemp directory under the native macOS /private/tmp root and symlink eval.scm to the same absolute candidate file. Reads and in-place writes retain file authority. Remove the owned directory in finally on success and failure; TMPDIR and normal workspace/cache paths remain unchanged.
Use Bun.$.escape for complete shell arguments and CTRF/reward redirection filenames. Actual Bash probes cover spaces, apostrophes, dollar signs, backticks, double quotes and backslashes.

Restore original interp.py, visible programs, hidden programs, and test_outputs.py after captured patch application. Remove only pytest configuration and conftest files on selected test ancestor paths.
Add observational conftest instrumentation that records original interpreter subprocess results and rethrows original timeout exceptions unchanged.
replacementLedger: Every grade report retains exact removed prefix, replacement strings and occurrence counts.
acceptance: Original pytest exit status zero AND reward.txt equal to 1. A settled verifier, captured original pytest status, consistent 0/1 reward and valid original CTRF artifact are required infrastructure evidence before any score is written. Missing or invalid authority and verifier timeouts throw, not failed-test scores. Aggregate criterion total is 1. Program and metacircular observations are optional evidence, not substitute acceptance criteria.
budgetDifference: The outer adapter adds 300 seconds for acquisition, installation and report settlement. The original 2400-second verifier budget is unchanged. The historical 25-minute candidate calibration is not the original container agent budget.
qualification: Run bun run bench/ab-steps/tasks-implement/scheme-metacircular/qualify.ts <external-evidence-directory>. This exercises the shared native loader, provisioner and capturer without provider, model, judge, or auth Usage calls.
equivalence: Native macOS arm64 qualification only; no claim of original container, leaderboard, Linux, or Windows equivalence.
pathQualification: Shared provision/capture controls cover spaces, apostrophe, dollar, backticks and double quote. A separate actual owned adapter reference grade covers those characters plus backslash. Bun 1.4.0 realpath returns ENOENT for existing macOS backslash filenames, so shared capture through a backslash TMPDIR remains unavailable outside this fixture-only change.
